purpose.zh: 练肩胛骨往下压的力量和稳定
purpose.en: Train pulling your shoulder blades down and holding them steady.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，只靠肩胛骨下沉把身体抬起
text.en: Keep your arms straight and lift yourself by pulling your shoulder blades down

text.zh: 正握单杠，比肩稍宽，双腿并拢。
text.en: Grip the bar overhand a little wider than your shoulders, legs together.

text.zh: 到顶停一秒，再慢慢回到吊着的姿势。
text.en: Hold for one second at the top, then lower slowly back to the hang.

commonErrors.zh: 弯手肘拉上去，变成小幅引体向上
commonErrors.en: Bending your elbows so it turns into a small pull-up.

cautions.en: Check that the bar is secure first.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前面夹着疼时减少次数
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, do fewer reps.

changes: 节奏按 spec 1.0/1.0/1.2/0.8（派生值偏离）
caution 拆成两条短句，「缩短时长」改「减少次数」（剂量是次数）
